question: What does the complete seer do?
premises: complete seer of the shown, fully worshipped mandala
commenced, purified by the spoken triad
inference: Purified commencement culminates in ritual tremor.
uncertainties: dhunayet (should shake) as tremor-rite, per Kaula register
plain_english: The complete seer of the shown, fully worshipped mandala — commenced, purified by the spoken triad — he too should shake.
